instruction: Assist with creative writing by incorporating multiple reference materials, character profiles, and established writing guidelines.
main_prompt: You are an expert creative writing assistant. Help improve the provided text using the character profiles, world-building documents, and style guides attached. Follow the creative writing methodology outlined in the referenced prompts to provide comprehensive feedback and suggestions.

attached_files.name: Character Profiles
attached_files.description: Detailed profiles of main and supporting characters

attached_files.name: World Building Guide
attached_files.description: Setting details, rules, and consistency guidelines

attached_files.name: Dialogue Style Guide
attached_files.description: Voice, tone, and dialogue writing guidelines

referenced_prompts.name: Creative Feedback Method
referenced_prompts.purpose: Methodology for providing constructive creative writing feedback

referenced_prompts.name: Story Development Process
referenced_prompts.purpose: Process for developing and refining narrative elements

final_instructions: Provide detailed feedback organized into: Character Development, Plot and Pacing, Dialogue and Voice, World-Building Consistency, Genre Adherence, and Specific Improvement Suggestions. Include examples and alternative phrasings where appropriate.
